name: Dot Matrix Display
description: A panel of round dots that spells messages in a 5×7 dot font, like a platform sign.

props.name: text
props.description: The message. A string with \n between lines, or an array with one entry per line. An entry can be a DotMatrixLine object { text, mode?, color?, align?, tone? } to scroll, colour, align ("left", "center", "right") or dim (tone "dim") that line on its own. Text is set in capitals from a 5×7 dot font with digits and common punctuation; accents are dropped.

props.name: rows
props.description: Dots down. Each line is 7 dots tall with 2 between lines. Defaults to fit the lines with a dot of margin.

props.name: cols
props.description: Dots across. The panel fills its container's width and the dots scale to fit.

props.name: mode
props.description: Default for every line. Static holds the text still; scroll holds it for a moment, then moves it left one column at a time and loops.

props.name: transition
props.description: How a line changes when its text does. Wipe sweeps a lit bar across; rain lets the old dots drop away and the new ones fall into place column by column; blink flashes the new text on. Under reduced motion lines change at once, and scrolling lines show their text a page at a time.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour of the lit dots. Use var(--chart-4) (yuzu) or var(--chart-5) (camellia) for notices.

props.name: speed
props.description: Scrolling speed in columns per second.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the housing. Other div props are passed through.
